tables.title: Mistakes (multilingual-embeddings)
rows: What drives the water cycle?
driven mainly by energy from the sun
The water cycle is the continuous movement of water between the earth and the atmosphere.
वर्षण किसे कहते हैं?
fall to the earth as precipitation
(said: not found)
Who discovered the water cycle?
(not in notes)
The water cycle is the continuous movement of water between the earth and the atmosphere.
Where does digestion begin?
Digestion begins in the mouth
Partly digested food moves into the small intestine, which is the longest part of the digestive system.
आमाशय में हाइड्रोक्लोरिक अम्ल क्या करता है?
Hydrochloric acid also kills
The stomach produces hydrochloric acid and enzymes that digest proteins.
How many teeth does an adult have?
(not in notes)
Digestion begins in the mouth, where teeth chew the food and saliva starts to break down starch.
What did the Declaration of the Rights of Man state?
all men are born free and equal
The National Assembly then issued the Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen.
Who was Napoleon Bonaparte?
(not in notes)
In 1793 the king was executed, and France became a republic.
What does the second law state?
force on an object equals its mass
The first law states that an object stays at rest or keeps moving in a straight line unless an unbalanced force acts on it.
न्यूटन का तीसरा नियम क्या है?
equal and opposite reaction
Isaac Newton described three laws that explain how objects move.

notes: Answerable questions count as correct when the top source sentence is the one that holds the answer.
Unanswerable questions count as correct when the bot says the notes don't contain the answer instead of guessing.
Cross-lingual = Hindi question on English notes or the reverse. TF-IDF needs to translate the question first; embeddings match across languages directly.
